final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id INNER JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), step2 AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_transaction_count FROM step1 GROUP BY town_city), step3 AS (SELECT s1.account_id, s1.town_city, s1.transaction_count, 1.0 * s1.transaction_count / NULLIF(s2.town_transaction_count, 0) AS account_share FROM step1 AS s1 INNER JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.town_city = s2.town_city), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count FROM step3) SELECT s3.account_id, s3.town_city, s3.transaction_count, s3.account_share, 1.0 * s3.transaction_count / NULLIF(s4.average_transaction_count, 0) AS relative_to_average FROM step3 AS s3 CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4 WHERE s4.average_transaction_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s3.account_share IS NULL), s3.account_share DESC LIMIT 10
